name: litigation-workbench
description: Six workflows for business litigation, including case treatment and a Shepard’s handoff.

interface.longDescription: Build a proof matrix, prepare an exhibit-linked deposition, reconcile a demand, design a Lexis research assignment, audit a brief, or check case treatment. Works with the sources the attorney supplies. The plugin contains written workflows and adds no external connections.
defaultPrompt: Build a proof matrix for the disputed propositions in the attached documents.
Reconcile this demand to the ledger and identify any unsupported payment triggers.
Can I still cite this case for the proposition in my brief? Check later treatment and list what I should Shepardize.
